I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I haven't run it.

It does three things:
- It backfills existing rows where `status` is NULL to `'queued'`.
- It sets the column default to `'queued'`.
- It sets the column to `NOT NULL`.

I didn't edit `001_init.sql`, because migrations are append-only and that file has already run in prod. The backfill comes first so `SET NOT NULL` doesn't fail on the NULL rows you're seeing. If some of those rows should have a different status, such as ones that already finished, change the backfill value before you apply this.

Since this touches the export schema, the team guidance is to tag @jordan on the PR.
